audience.public_segment: South African independent-school academic leaders, assessment coordinators and educators

hypothesis: If ISASA is shown 'Cross-phase live proof: Grade 3 Mathematics activity-style pack vs Grade 10 Dance Studies performance task, each with memo/rubric and educator approval.', then the Academic/curriculum decision-maker is more likely to request a bounded pilot because the offer addresses a specific workflow pain without surrendering human authority.

experiment.channel: Reviewed member-bulletin submission + proof landing page
experiment.proof_summary: Eight Grade 12 Term 3 subject packs with separate memoranda, source-grounded papers, embedded media and educator approval boundaries.
experiment.public_hook: One curriculum spine should not produce eight identical-looking papers. Watch HOMS change the assessment architecture with the subject.
experiment.cta: Review the tight-eight proof and request one subject-and-grade pilot.
experiment.kill_condition: No qualified engagement after two permission-safe attempts or channel test; re-evaluate message/fit before any further approach.

gates.reason: Research and proof-content generation are allowed; no valid electronic sales permission is recorded.
